Description:
Feature ID: SCRUM03-F001
Classification: Explicit Requirement
Source Document: Scrum Team 3_IT_batchA_MITAU_20260807.docx

Description: Consolidated view of a student's attendance, internal marks, and exam information sourced from existing college portals.

Business Objective: Let students monitor academic performance in one place instead of visiting multiple portals.

Actors/Roles: Student, External Academic Portal(s)

Functional Requirements:
- Display current attendance percentage.
- Display internal marks by subject.
- Display exam schedule/information.

Business Rules:
- Data displayed must reflect the source portal's latest values (no independent editing by students).

Dependencies:
- Integration with existing college academic portal(s) — external system, not owned by this Scrum.

Assumptions:
- Assumption: the college's existing academic systems expose data via an API or extractable feed; not confirmed in source document.

Open Questions:
- Open Question: which specific academic portals/systems must be integrated, and do they provide APIs? Needs Clarification.

Summary: [SCRUM03-F002] Announcements, Placement Updates & Study Materials Aggregator
Description:
Feature ID: SCRUM03-F002
Classification: Explicit Requirement
Source Document: Scrum Team 3_IT_batchA_MITAU_20260807.docx

Description: Aggregates announcements from various portals, placement updates from CUIC, and access to study materials in one feed.

Business Objective: Prevent missed announcements/deadlines and centralize access to placement and study content.

Actors/Roles: Student, CUIC (Placement Cell), External Portals

Functional Requirements:
- Aggregate announcements from multiple source portals into one feed.
- Display placement updates sourced from CUIC.
- Provide access to study materials.

Business Rules:
- Announcements must display source and timestamp for traceability.

Dependencies:
- Integration with CUIC placement system and other announcement-source portals.

Assumptions:
- Assumption: CUIC exposes updates via an accessible feed/API.

Open Questions:
- Open Question: is CUIC integration a live API or a manually curated feed? Not specified.

Summary: [SCRUM03-F003] AI Study Assistant (Question Paper Analysis & Recommendations)
Description:
Feature ID: SCRUM03-F003
Classification: Explicit Requirement
Source Document: Scrum Team 3_IT_batchA_MITAU_20260807.docx

Description: AI-powered features that analyze previous question papers, provide syllabus insights, and generate study recommendations, including an AI Smart Question Paper Predictor.

Business Objective: Help students prepare smarter by surfacing high-priority exam topics.

Actors/Roles: Student

Functional Requirements:
- Analyze previous question papers to identify recurring patterns/topics.
- Provide syllabus insights and study recommendations.
- Highlight frequently-asked topics to prioritize.

Business Rules:
- Predictions must be presented as guidance, not guaranteed exam content.

Dependencies:
- Feature SCRUM03-F002 for sourcing study materials/question papers.

Assumptions:
- Assumption: historical question papers are available in digital form for analysis; not confirmed.

Open Questions:
- Open Question: source and volume of historical question papers required to train/support the predictor is unspecified.

Story ID: SCRUM03-F001-UI-001

User Story: As a student, I want to see my attendance, marks, and exam info on one dashboard, so that I don't need to check multiple portals.

Description: Dashboard screen with attendance %, marks summary, and upcoming exam list.

Business Value: Saves time and improves visibility into academic standing.

Acceptance Criteria:
AC1. Given a logged-in student opens the dashboard, when data loads successfully, then attendance, marks, and exam info are displayed.
AC2. Given the source portal data cannot be fetched, when the dashboard loads, then a clear 'data unavailable' message is shown instead of blank/broken UI.

Dependencies: Depends on Backend aggregation API.
Assumptions: N/A
Technical Notes: N/A
Definition of Done: Dashboard implemented and tested against sample/mock data.

Story ID: SCRUM03-F001-BE-001

User Story: As the dashboard UI, I want to fetch a student's academic data from the source portals, so that I can display it in one place.

Description: Backend service that pulls/aggregates attendance, marks, and exam data per student.

Business Value: Core aggregation capability underpinning the hub concept.

Acceptance Criteria:
AC1. Given a student ID is provided, when the source system responds successfully, then normalized academic data is returned.
AC2. Given a source portal integration fails, when the request is processed, then a defined error/fallback response is returned instead of an unhandled failure.

Dependencies: Depends on Integration story SCRUM03-F001-INT-001.
Assumptions: N/A
Technical Notes: TBD — requires technical confirmation of source system APIs.
Definition of Done: Service implemented and tested.

Story ID: SCRUM03-F001-DB-001

User Story: As the system, I want to cache fetched academic data locally, so that the dashboard loads quickly and remains available if the source portal is briefly unreachable.

Description: Local cache table storing last-synced attendance/marks/exam data per student with a sync timestamp.

Business Value: Improves performance and resilience.

Acceptance Criteria:
AC1. Given data is successfully fetched from a source portal, when processed, then it is cached with an updated sync timestamp.

Dependencies: Depends on aggregation service.
Assumptions: Assumption: caching is acceptable given data is read-mostly; refresh frequency TBD.
Technical Notes: TBD — requires technical confirmation of refresh/cache-invalidation strategy.
Definition of Done: Cache schema implemented.

Story ID: SCRUM03-F001-INT-001

User Story: As the system, I want to connect to the existing academic portal(s), so that attendance, marks, and exam data can be retrieved automatically.

Description: API/data integration with external academic systems (producer: college portal, consumer: AIO Hub backend).

Business Value: Eliminates duplicate manual data entry and keeps data current.

Acceptance Criteria:
AC1. Given valid student credentials/authorization are available, when a data pull is triggered, then attendance, marks, and exam data are retrieved and mapped to the hub's data model.
AC2. Given the external portal times out, when a pull is attempted, then the integration retries per a defined policy and logs the failure if retries are exhausted.

Dependencies: Cross-Scrum/External dependency — portal ownership and API availability unconfirmed.
Assumptions: Assumption: portals are external/legacy systems outside the 7 Scrums.
Technical Notes: TBD — requires technical confirmation of endpoint, auth method, retry, and timeout behavior.
Definition of Done: Integration built against a mock/test endpoint and verified.

Summary: [SCRUM03-E2E-001] Student views up-to-date academic status pulled from source portals
Description:
Covers Features: SCRUM03-F001

Business Journey: Student logs in → hub aggregation service pulls attendance/marks/exam data from source portals → data is cached → dashboard displays current status.

E2E Acceptance Criteria:
AC1. Given a student opens the academic dashboard, when source portal data is available, then current attendance, marks, and exam data are shown, matching the source portal values.

Error/Exception Path: If a source portal is unreachable, the dashboard shows the last successfully cached data with a 'last updated' indicator rather than failing outright.

Summary: [SCRUM03-E2E-002] Student discovers an announcement, related study material, and AI-prioritized topics
Description:
Covers Features: SCRUM03-F002, SCRUM03-F003

Business Journey: Student opens unified feed → sees a new exam announcement → navigates to study materials for that subject → opens AI insights to see prioritized topics.

E2E Acceptance Criteria:
AC1. Given an announcement about an upcoming exam exists, when the student follows the flow from feed to study materials to AI insights, then all three screens present consistent, subject-matched information.

Error/Exception Path: Missing study materials or insufficient AI analysis data for a subject is communicated clearly rather than shown as an empty/broken screen.
